reason: The recorder timed out waiting for recovery while a concurrent local Compose image build/start overloaded the shared workstation. Kubernetes readiness failures and pod restarts were observed. The extra Compose stack was stopped and the cluster recovered.
limitations: This attempt predates interrupted-frame persistence. Its in-memory frames were not saved. No recovery duration is asserted or included in successful-run statistics. The resumed recorder repeats the missing run and retains all completed captures.
